storyboard.ears: The nuclear buildout is active, large, and concentrated in one country.
Ten nuclear reactor projects started construction in 2025. The worldwide buildout is still adding new projects.
storyboard.evidence: International Energy Agency (IEA) | New nuclear reactor construction starts worldwide per year | https://www.iea.org/reports/global-energy-review-2026/technology-nuclear | 2026-11-01

storyboard.ears: China holds 50% of nuclear capacity under construction. Half of the active buildout is concentrated there.

storyboard.ears: Worldwide nuclear construction totals 78 gigawatts. That concentrated pipeline adds up to substantial generating capacity.
